description: Fighting-engine tuning. Game analysis of 1024 Lichess games showed MetalFish draws ~87% of games, almost all from genuinely equal (<=50cp) positions, capping its Elo. MCTSContempt applies a draw-score penalty in the MCTS Q-backup (draw_score = -contempt/10000) so the engine avoids drawish lines and keeps winning chances. Each candidate plays a colour-balanced self-play match against the draw-neutral baseline (MCTSContempt=0). Positive Elo with a lower CI bound above 0 means the setting is a real gain.

candidates.label: contempt-100
candidates.note: Very mild draw aversion (~3cp penalty on fully-drawn nodes).

candidates.label: contempt-350
candidates.note: Moderate draw aversion; near the historical 'contempt 300' commit.

candidates.label: contempt-500
candidates.note: Strong draw aversion (~15cp penalty on fully-drawn nodes).

candidates.label: contempt-750
candidates.note: Aggressive draw aversion; watch for increased losses vs stronger play.

candidates.label: contempt-1000
candidates.note: Maximum-tested draw aversion (~30cp penalty); upper end of the sweep.
